# testdata/settle1i

Synthetic fixtures for the SETTLE-1i acceptance (dist/test/settle1i.sh): a value counts as kept
when anything the distill run filed holds it. One conversation, one reply:

- line 1 (concept-held): Brannoch, Vessa and Ostmere are filed only inside a concept claim;
- line 2 (entry-held): Halloran, 4,750 and Pellridge are only in the entry's body;
- line 3 (vanished): Quintrell and Larchmont are filed nowhere and not skipped;
- line 4 (whole token): Cal is not kept by "calendar" in the entry's body.

Every person, place and figure here is invented.
